caption: The curtains of a sunny window are pulled open, and the shadow of the window frame appears on the floor.

sa.check: The curtains of a window are pulled open.
The shadow of the window frame appears on the floor.
The curtains open first and the pattern appears with them.

pc.expect: A bright patch with the dark bars of the frame appears on the floor as the curtains open, on the side away from the window.
pc.fail: The pattern is there with the curtains shut; or it appears on the window side; or the curtains open and no pattern appears in sunlight.

pc.expect: The bars match the frame's layout.
pc.fail: The bars are a different pattern from the frame; or there are more bars than the frame has; or the pattern is a solid shape.

pc.expect: The pattern does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It slides across the floor with the curtains still; or it appears and vanishes with no curtain movement.

pc.expect: The patch widens as the curtains open and would narrow as they close.
pc.fail: It narrows as the curtains open; or it is full width before the curtains move; or it flickers.

pc.expect: One window and one pattern of it.
pc.fail: A second window's pattern appears; or the frame vanishes; or the pattern becomes solid; or the curtains pass through the frame.

pc.expect: The curtains, the frame and the floor stay the same, and the bars stay dark.
pc.fail: The curtains change colour; or the bars turn coloured; or the floor changes.
